## Summary

Describe the skill, maintaining team, local or remote mode, and intended user prompts.

## Publication checks

- [ ] Local identity points to this catalog; remote components record their upstream source. Existing authorship is preserved.
- [ ] Any adaptations are described accurately; third-party sources are allowed.
- [ ] A catalog maintainer owns ongoing review and approved public release.
- [ ] Quality Gate, catalog checks and DCO pass on this PR before merge.
- [ ] Third-party attribution, license, and NOTICE requirements are preserved.
- [ ] The source license permits redistribution.
- [ ] Required license/NOTICE material is preserved; original local contributions default to root Apache-2.0 without a mandatory duplicate LICENSE.
- [ ] Executable scripts and dependencies were reviewed.
- [ ] `skill-card.md` records owner, source, license, lifecycle, and non-empty runtime/permission information or a SKILL.md reference.
- [ ] The published skill is flat and contains no nested `SKILL.md` or sibling-skill dependency.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, customer data, or unpublished information are included.
- [ ] Local validation and generated-catalog checks pass.
- [ ] Pinned Agent Skills reference validation passes; remote provenance checks also pass for any registered remote components.
- [ ] CLI discovery lists only intended published skills, not templates or staging content.
- [ ] Commits include [DCO sign-off](https://developercertificate.org/).

No Validation section or eval dataset is required. Local `contribute.py check`
does not execute the skill or replace the PR Quality Gate, DCO, and human review.
Leave pending checks unchecked: a queued Quality Gate is not a pass.
